reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_code, c.cal_date, COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity), 0) AS units
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN calendar c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = c.cal_date
LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE s.country_code = 'NL' AND c.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-06' AND DATE '2025-03-09'
GROUP BY s.store_code, c.cal_date

solver.query:
WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT o.store_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) AS d, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-06 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.store_id, CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE)
)
SELECT s.store_code, c.cal_date, COALESCE(ou.units, 0) AS units
FROM stores s
CROSS JOIN calendar c
LEFT JOIN order_units ou ON ou.store_id = s.store_id AND ou.d = c.cal_date
WHERE (s.country_code = 'NL' OR s.store_code = 'WEB-01')
  AND c.cal_date >= DATE '2025-03-06' AND c.cal_date <= DATE '2025-03-09'
